evaluation_protocol.scores: predict_proba positive-class probability; computed once and reused
evaluation_protocol.threshold_candidates: unique validation scores of the evaluated rows
evaluation_protocol.f1_definition: 2*TP/(2*TP+FP+FN); null when precision or recall is undefined
evaluation_protocol.interpretation: Full-validation and Window 2 optima are retrospective diagnostics, not independently validated or production thresholds.

temporal_windows.boundary_rule: window_1: time <= boundary_time; window_2: time > boundary_time; boundary minimizes |n_window_1 - n_window_2|, earlier boundary on ties

threshold_transfer.f1_difference_definition: transferred F1 - retrospective Window 2 optimal F1

common_reference_thresholds.role: descriptive comparison; not a transfer test
common_reference_thresholds.note: Separate from threshold_transfer (Window 1 max-F1 frozen and applied to Window 2). Here each reference threshold is applied independently to both windows using the scores already computed; no refitting or rescoring.

fixed_0_5.description: fixed reference; diagnostic only, not an operational threshold

full_validation_max_f1.description: retrospective: selected on full validation, which includes the labels of both windows
